map.文本转 Slug是做什么的？: What does Text to Slug do?
map.如何使用文本转 Slug？: How do I use Text to Slug?
map.文本转 Slug适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Text to Slug best for?
map.Hello World! 这是中文标题示例 2024: Hello World! This is a Chinese title example 2024
map.URL 友好化：把标题转成小写、连字符分隔的 slug，用于文章/商品链接。: URL-friendliness: turn a title into a lowercase, hyphen-separated slug for article/product links.
map.文件名规范化：把含空格中文的名字转成安全文件名或目录。: Filename normalization: turn a name with spaces or Chinese into a safe filename or directory.
map.SEO 与可读性：生成人类可读且无乱码的永久链接。: SEO and readability: generate human-readable, corruption-free permanent links.
map.输入「Hello World!」，转得「hello-world」，去除标点、转小: Input "Hello World!", get "hello-world": punctuation removed, lowercased, spaces become hyphens; used for clean URLs like /posts/hello-world.
map.需转拼音再连字符（如「教程」→「jiao-cheng」），否则直接去非 ASCI: Convert to pinyin then hyphenate (e.g. "course" → "jiao-cheng"); otherwise stripping non-ASCII loses meaning. Whether to pinyinize depends on the option; pure non-ASCII removal empties Chinese.
map.会。多个空格/标点产生的连续「-」会折叠为单个，避免「hello--world」: Yes. Multiple spaces/punctuation produce consecutive "-" which collapse into one, avoiding ugly slugs like "hello--world".
